title: Supplier
description: One entry of the approved supplier list, at supply-chain/suppliers/<id>.json (route supply-chain/suppliers/[id]): who supplies the venture with materials, parts, manufacturing or logistics, what they may supply, whether a person approved them and how risky the supply is. It follows ISO 9001:2015 clause 8.4 (control of externally provided processes, products and services: criteria for selecting, evaluating and re-evaluating suppliers) and APQC PCF 4.2.2 (select suppliers and develop and maintain contracts), with the Kraljic matrix (Kraljic, HBR 1983) for the risk class. The supply-chain function owns it, and only the supply-chain agent (role supply-chain-agent) or a person writes it. Approval is a person's: an agent may draft a candidate, and approved_by names the person who approved it. Contacts and bank details are not kept here.

id.description: The supplier's id, the file name without .json

supplies.description: What the supplier may supply: parts, materials, assembly, packaging, freight, warehousing

kind.description: What sort of supplier it is; a third-party logistics provider (3PL) is warehouse or logistics

status.description: candidate until a person approves it; conditional is approved with open findings; suspended stops new orders

approved_on.description: When a person approved it, or null

approved_by.description: The person who approved it, never an agent

review_due.description: When the supplier is next re-evaluated (ISO 9001 8.4.1 re-evaluation); yearly by default

risk_class.description: The Kraljic quadrant of what it supplies: profit impact against supply risk

single_source.description: True when nobody else is approved to supply the same item. A bottleneck or strategic single source needs a recorded decision: second source, buffer stock or accept the risk

country.description: Where it ships from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code

certifications.description: Certifications the supplier holds, such as ISO 9001:2015

lead_time_days.description: Quoted lead time from order to ship, in days

moq.description: Minimum order quantity in its quoted unit
